subject: FY26 Budget Public Engagement Survey Results
overview: The committee approved the May council newsletter and reviewed data from a public engagement survey regarding FY26 budget priorities. Members also discussed feedback from a recent listening session held at the Senior Center.

items.title: May Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the May newsletter with edits to clarify the Human Rights Commission ordinance and the operating hours for a recently amended Common Victualler license. The final version includes links to all city boards and commissions and summaries of recent legislative actions.

items.title: FY26 Budget Survey Report
items.summary: Reviewed results from 110 survey respondents which identified schools and infrastructure as top short-term priorities, while housing and climate concerns were highlighted as long-term needs. The committee approved distributing the report to the full City Council and placing the matter on file.

items.title: Listening Session Update
items.summary: Received a report on a recent listening session at the Senior Center where residents discussed infrastructure maintenance, speed limit enforcement, and the need for a printed directory of city contact information for those without computer access. The matter was kept in committee.
